# Shennong

Shennong is an R package for single-cell, multimodal, spatial, and bulk
transcriptomics. It brings preprocessing, clustering, differential
analysis, pathway analysis, and plotting into a common workflow, and
keeps analytical results with their inputs and parameters on a Seurat
object.

**New here?** Follow [Get
started](https://zerostwo.github.io/shennong/dev/articles/get-started.html)
for a complete example using bundled data. No data download or Python
setup is needed. The package is in development, and documented API
changes may be breaking.

## Install

``` r

install.packages(c("remotes", "Seurat"))
remotes::install_github("zerostwo/shennong")
library(Shennong)
```

Install optional backends only for the workflows you need. Use
[`sn_list_methods()`](https://zerostwo.github.io/shennong/dev/reference/sn_list_methods.md)
and
[`sn_get_method_status()`](https://zerostwo.github.io/shennong/dev/reference/sn_get_method_status.md)
to inspect availability; [Choose a
backend](https://zerostwo.github.io/shennong/dev/articles/method-catalog.html)
lists methods and their execution requirements.

## A first analysis

This small example uses PBMC counts bundled with SeuratObject. Its
clusters illustrate the API and are not cell-type annotations or
condition-level tests.

``` r

data("pbmc_small", package = "SeuratObject")
pbmc <- SeuratObject::CreateSeuratObject(
  SeuratObject::GetAssayData(pbmc_small, assay = "RNA", layer = "counts")
)
pbmc <- sn_run_cluster(
  pbmc, integration_method = "unintegrated",
  nfeatures = 100, npcs = 10, dims = 1:10, resolution = 1.2, seed = 717,
  verbose = FALSE
)
sn_plot_dim(pbmc, reduction = "umap", group_by = "seurat_clusters")

pbmc <- sn_find_de(
  pbmc, analysis = "markers", group_by = "seurat_clusters",
  result_id = "markers", verbose = FALSE
)
sn_get_de_result(pbmc, "markers", direction = "up", top_n = 3)
```

`top_n = 3` selects up to three genes **per group**. Use
`top_scope = "all"` for three genes overall. Keep the complete result
for later use:

``` r

sn_list_results(pbmc, type = "de")
result <- sn_get_result(pbmc, type = "de", result_id = "markers")
head(result$tables$primary)
saveRDS(pbmc, "pbmc-analysed.rds")
```

Assign an object-returning workflow back to `pbmc` to retain its result.
Use `return_object = FALSE` on DE, enrichment, scoring, or Milo to
receive a unified result directly. See [Parameters and
results](https://zerostwo.github.io/shennong/dev/articles/parameters-and-results.html)
for return values, result IDs, filters, and safe reruns.

## Find the right guide

| I want to… | Guide |
|----|----|
| Learn the core workflow with runnable examples | [Get started](https://zerostwo.github.io/shennong/dev/articles/get-started.html) |
| Understand parameters, grouping, and stored results | [Parameters and results](https://zerostwo.github.io/shennong/dev/articles/parameters-and-results.html) |
| Import data, filter cells, and normalize | [Data IO](https://zerostwo.github.io/shennong/dev/articles/data-io-projects.html) · [Preprocessing](https://zerostwo.github.io/shennong/dev/articles/preprocessing-qc.html) |
| Cluster cells or integrate batches | [Clustering and integration](https://zerostwo.github.io/shennong/dev/articles/clustering.html) |
| Find markers, compare conditions, and enrich pathways | [Differential expression and enrichment](https://zerostwo.github.io/shennong/dev/articles/differential-expression.html) |
| Score signatures or annotate cells | [Annotation and pathways](https://zerostwo.github.io/shennong/dev/articles/annotation-pathways.html) |
| Compare composition or neighborhood abundance | [Composition and Milo](https://zerostwo.github.io/shennong/dev/articles/composition-analysis.html) |
| Plot expression and analytical results | [Visualization](https://zerostwo.github.io/shennong/dev/articles/visualization.html) |
| Work with spatial, bulk, or cell dynamics data | [All workflows](https://zerostwo.github.io/shennong/dev/articles/index.html) |
| Look up a specific function or backend | [Function reference](https://zerostwo.github.io/shennong/dev/reference/index.html) · [Backend catalog](https://zerostwo.github.io/shennong/dev/articles/method-catalog.html) |

The introductory examples run on bundled data. The larger real-data
workflows state their required files and optional dependencies; they do
not download study data during a normal website build. Use your own data
with the documented input structure, or follow the [research workflow
map](https://zerostwo.github.io/shennong/dev/articles/research-workflow-map.html)
for the public-data narratives. Dataset discovery and materialization
live in [ShennongData](https://github.com/zerostwo/shennong-data).

See the [release
notes](https://zerostwo.github.io/shennong/dev/news/index.html) for
breaking changes. Report reproducible problems in the [issue
tracker](https://github.com/zerostwo/shennong/issues).

# Package index

## Analysis Methods and Result Contract

- [`sn_list_methods()`](https://zerostwo.github.io/shennong/dev/reference/sn_list_methods.md)
  : List registered Shennong analysis methods

- [`sn_get_method_status()`](https://zerostwo.github.io/shennong/dev/reference/sn_get_method_status.md)
  : Report the status of a registered Shennong method

- [`sn_method_status()`](https://zerostwo.github.io/shennong/dev/reference/sn_method_status.md)
  :

  Deprecated alias of
  [`sn_get_method_status()`](https://zerostwo.github.io/shennong/dev/reference/sn_get_method_status.md)

- [`sn_store_result()`](https://zerostwo.github.io/shennong/dev/reference/sn_store_result.md)
  : Store a Shennong analysis result on a Seurat object

- [`sn_get_result()`](https://zerostwo.github.io/shennong/dev/reference/sn_get_result.md)
  : Retrieve a stored Shennong analysis result

- [`sn_list_results()`](https://zerostwo.github.io/shennong/dev/reference/sn_list_results.md)
  : List stored Shennong analysis and interpretation results on a Seurat
  object

- [`sn_audit_results()`](https://zerostwo.github.io/shennong/dev/reference/sn_audit_results.md)
  : Audit stored Shennong analysis results

- [`sn_upgrade_results()`](https://zerostwo.github.io/shennong/dev/reference/sn_upgrade_results.md)
  : Upgrade stored Shennong analysis results

- [`sn_delete_result()`](https://zerostwo.github.io/shennong/dev/reference/sn_delete_result.md)
  : Delete a stored Shennong analysis result

- [`sn_delete_artifact()`](https://zerostwo.github.io/shennong/dev/reference/sn_delete_artifact.md)
  : Delete a registered workflow artifact

- [`sn_validate_result()`](https://zerostwo.github.io/shennong/dev/reference/sn_validate_result.md)
  : Validate a Shennong analysis result

- [`sn_build_result_bundle()`](https://zerostwo.github.io/shennong/dev/reference/result_bundle.md)
  [`sn_validate_result_bundle()`](https://zerostwo.github.io/shennong/dev/reference/result_bundle.md)
  [`sn_export_result_bundle()`](https://zerostwo.github.io/shennong/dev/reference/result_bundle.md)
  : Build, validate, and export a Shennong Result Bundle v1

- [`sn_check_acceleration()`](https://zerostwo.github.io/shennong/dev/reference/sn_check_acceleration.md)
  : Check the current acceleration status

- [`sn_enable_acceleration()`](https://zerostwo.github.io/shennong/dev/reference/sn_enable_acceleration.md)
  : Activate ShennongOpt acceleration patches

- [`sn_disable_acceleration()`](https://zerostwo.github.io/shennong/dev/reference/sn_disable_acceleration.md)
  : Deactivate ShennongOpt acceleration patches

- [`sn_with_acceleration()`](https://zerostwo.github.io/shennong/dev/reference/sn_with_acceleration.md)
  : Run an expression with selected acceleration patches active

- [`sn_create_usage_store()`](https://zerostwo.github.io/shennong/dev/reference/sn_create_usage_store.md)
  : Create a local or managed-remote usage store

- [`sn_confirm_usage_consent()`](https://zerostwo.github.io/shennong/dev/reference/sn_confirm_usage_consent.md)
  : Record explicit consent for usage research

- [`sn_enable_usage_tracking()`](https://zerostwo.github.io/shennong/dev/reference/sn_enable_usage_tracking.md)
  : Enable local workflow usage and timing records

- [`sn_disable_usage_tracking()`](https://zerostwo.github.io/shennong/dev/reference/sn_disable_usage_tracking.md)
  : Disable local workflow usage tracking

- [`sn_with_usage_tracking()`](https://zerostwo.github.io/shennong/dev/reference/sn_with_usage_tracking.md)
  : Evaluate code with temporary local usage tracking

- [`sn_check_usage_tracking()`](https://zerostwo.github.io/shennong/dev/reference/sn_check_usage_tracking.md)
  : Check local workflow usage tracking state

- [`sn_flush_usage_tracking()`](https://zerostwo.github.io/shennong/dev/reference/sn_flush_usage_tracking.md)
  : Flush the local usage outbox to a managed remote DBI store

- [`sn_list_usage_runs()`](https://zerostwo.github.io/shennong/dev/reference/sn_list_usage_runs.md)
  : List local workflow usage records

- [`sn_summarize_usage()`](https://zerostwo.github.io/shennong/dev/reference/sn_summarize_usage.md)
  : Summarize local workflow usage and runtime

- [`sn_time_call()`](https://zerostwo.github.io/shennong/dev/reference/sn_time_call.md)
  : Time an R expression

## Preprocessing and QC

- [`sn_get_species()`](https://zerostwo.github.io/shennong/dev/reference/sn_get_species.md)
  : Retrieve or infer species information
- [`sn_initialize_seurat_object()`](https://zerostwo.github.io/shennong/dev/reference/sn_initialize_seurat_object.md)
  : Initialize a Seurat object with optional QC metrics
- [`sn_add_qc_metrics()`](https://zerostwo.github.io/shennong/dev/reference/sn_add_qc_metrics.md)
  : Add or refresh count-based QC percentages
- [`sn_standardize_gene_symbols()`](https://zerostwo.github.io/shennong/dev/reference/sn_standardize_gene_symbols.md)
  : Standardize gene symbols in a vector, count matrix, or Seurat object
- [`sn_normalize_data()`](https://zerostwo.github.io/shennong/dev/reference/sn_normalize_data.md)
  : Normalize data in a Seurat object
- [`sn_score_cell_cycle()`](https://zerostwo.github.io/shennong/dev/reference/sn_score_cell_cycle.md)
  : Score Cell Cycle Phases
- [`sn_filter_genes()`](https://zerostwo.github.io/shennong/dev/reference/sn_filter_genes.md)
  : Filter genes based on the number of expressing cells
- [`sn_filter_cells()`](https://zerostwo.github.io/shennong/dev/reference/sn_filter_cells.md)
  : Filter cells in a Seurat object based on QC metrics
- [`sn_assess_qc()`](https://zerostwo.github.io/shennong/dev/reference/sn_assess_qc.md)
  : Assess overall QC status and before/after filtering outcomes
- [`sn_find_doublets()`](https://zerostwo.github.io/shennong/dev/reference/sn_find_doublets.md)
  : Find doublets with scDblFinder or Scrublet
- [`sn_remove_ambient_contamination()`](https://zerostwo.github.io/shennong/dev/reference/sn_remove_ambient_contamination.md)
  : Remove ambient RNA contamination from counts

## Diagnostics and Benchmarking

  : Assess integration quality across multiple metrics

  : Compare integration methods with scib-metrics

  : Detect rare cells with native or optional rare-cell backends

  : Calculate LISI scores from a Seurat embedding
- [`sn_calculate_silhouette()`](https://zerostwo.github.io/shennong/dev/reference/sn_calculate_silhouette.md)
  : Calculate silhouette widths from a Seurat embedding
- [`sn_calculate_graph_connectivity()`](https://zerostwo.github.io/shennong/dev/reference/sn_calculate_graph_connectivity.md)
  : Calculate graph connectivity for a grouping label
- [`sn_calculate_pcr_batch()`](https://zerostwo.github.io/shennong/dev/reference/sn_calculate_pcr_batch.md)
  : Calculate PCR batch_by effect scores
- [`sn_calculate_variance_explained()`](https://zerostwo.github.io/shennong/dev/reference/sn_calculate_variance_explained.md)
  : Rank metadata variables by embedding variance explained
- [`sn_calculate_clustering_agreement()`](https://zerostwo.github.io/shennong/dev/reference/sn_calculate_clustering_agreement.md)
  : Calculate agreement between clusters and reference labels
- [`sn_calculate_isolated_label_score()`](https://zerostwo.github.io/shennong/dev/reference/sn_calculate_isolated_label_score.md)
  : Calculate isolated-label preservation scores
- [`sn_calculate_cluster_purity()`](https://zerostwo.github.io/shennong/dev/reference/sn_calculate_cluster_purity.md)
  : Calculate cluster purity against a reference label
- [`sn_calculate_cluster_entropy()`](https://zerostwo.github.io/shennong/dev/reference/sn_calculate_cluster_entropy.md)
  : Calculate cluster_by entropy for a categorical label
- [`sn_identify_challenging_groups()`](https://zerostwo.github.io/shennong/dev/reference/sn_identify_challenging_groups.md)
  : Identify rare or difficult-to-separate groups
- [`sn_calculate_rogue()`](https://zerostwo.github.io/shennong/dev/reference/sn_calculate_rogue.md)
  : Calculate ROGUE score for Seurat Object

## Annotation, Markers, and Pathways

- [`sn_run_annotation()`](https://zerostwo.github.io/shennong/dev/reference/sn_run_annotation.md)
  : Run reference-based cell-type annotation

- [`sn_map_cell_ontology()`](https://zerostwo.github.io/shennong/dev/reference/sn_map_cell_ontology.md)
  : Map cell labels to Cell Ontology identifiers

- [`sn_review_annotation()`](https://zerostwo.github.io/shennong/dev/reference/sn_review_annotation.md)
  : Review stored annotation evidence and low-confidence labels

- [`sn_plot_annotation_confidence()`](https://zerostwo.github.io/shennong/dev/reference/sn_plot_annotation_confidence.md)
  : Plot annotation confidence

- [`sn_plot_annotation_confusion()`](https://zerostwo.github.io/shennong/dev/reference/sn_plot_annotation_confusion.md)
  : Plot annotation confusion against known labels

- [`sn_run_celltypist()`](https://zerostwo.github.io/shennong/dev/reference/sn_run_celltypist.md)
  : Run CellTypist for automated cell type annotation

- [`sn_find_de()`](https://zerostwo.github.io/shennong/dev/reference/sn_find_de.md)
  : Run differential expression analysis on a Seurat object

# Articles

### Start here

Run a complete example, learn the shared controls, then choose an
analysis.

- [Get started: counts to markers and
  scores](https://zerostwo.github.io/shennong/dev/articles/get-started.md):

  patterns](https://zerostwo.github.io/shennong/dev/articles/parameters-and-results.md):

  enrichment](https://zerostwo.github.io/shennong/dev/articles/differential-expression.md):
- [Choose a
  backend](https://zerostwo.github.io/shennong/dev/articles/method-catalog.md):
- [From samples to evidence: a research workflow
  map](https://zerostwo.github.io/shennong/dev/articles/research-workflow-map.md):
